en.headline: Burglars steal watches and jewellery worth HK$440,000 from Sai Kung house
en.dek: A domestic helper discovered a pried-open window at a detached house in Nam Shan San Tsuen while the owners were overseas, with items including an H. Stern watch missing.
body: Police are investigating a burglary at a detached house in Sai Kung’s Nam Shan San Tsuen after a domestic helper found a window forced open early on Monday.
The helper noticed the damage and signs of ransacking while cleaning at about 6.38am and contacted her 75-year-old employer, who was overseas with his family, before calling the police.

Officers said preliminary checks showed watches and jewellery valued at about HK$440,000 were missing, including an H. Stern watch estimated at HK$78,000, along with bracelets, rings and earrings. The case has been classified as burglary and is being handled by the Wong Tai Sin district criminal investigation team. No arrests have been made.

zh.headline: 西貢南山新村獨立屋遭撬窗爆竊 失約44萬元珠寶手錶
zh.dek: 屋主一家身在海外，外傭清晨發現房間窗戶被撬，屋內有搜掠痕跡，損失包括一隻H.Stern手錶及其他首飾。
body: 西貢南山新村一間獨立屋周一清晨發生爆竊案。警方接報，一名外傭於約6時38分進行清潔時，發現房間窗戶被撬開，屋內有搜掠痕跡，隨即通知身在海外的僱主並報警。
75歲姓楊的男屋主與家人當時在海外。警方到場調查後，初步點算損失約值44萬港元的珠寶及手錶，包括一隻巴西品牌H.Stern手錶，價值約7.8萬元，以及手鐲、戒指及耳環等。
案件已列作爆竊，交由黃大仙警區刑事調查隊跟進，暫未有人被捕。警方相信賊人趁深夜或凌晨防範較鬆懈時撬窗入屋。
